name: WDI/UIS/ILO sweep (massification panel)
coverage: 60+ series; pre_ger 207 countries 1970-2022; prm_ner 197/1970-2019; sec_ner 188; lsc 197/1970-2024; test_scores & hci 172/2010-2020; child_work (ILO/UCW 7-14) 100/1994-2016 median 2 obs/country; gdppc 213/1960-2024; fertility 217/1960-2024; repeat_prm 201/1970-2019; prm_cmp 198/1970-2024
vintage: WDI API pull ~2026-11-11 (header lastupdated); UIS/ILO-modelled mixes
limitations: mixed vintages; ILO modelled child work; no child-work state decomposition (only total); no tutoring series; UIS vs national definitions
construct_mismatch: GER gross vs model participation share; attainment vs participation; child work 7-14 vs model's age-less 4-state; test-score scale vs model grade-equivalents

name: E1 multiverse WDI panel (derived)
unit: derived link statistics (272 links) from 17 WDI variables, 179 countries 1940-2025
coverage: 272 = 136 unordered pairs x 2 specs; 1,200 draws + 1 real pass
vintage: new WDI pull (vintage differs from original; E1 reproduction max |delta t| 3.97e-5)
limitations: RAW PANEL NOT COMMITTED (lived on /root/work/data on another host); no re-pull allowed; derived only
construct_mismatch: cannot be re-fitted; 17 macro variables, none of the MASSENG child-work states

name: Q2 long-run panel
unit: country x year: child mortality, life expectancy, effective fertility, TFR, mean years schooling, Maddison GDP pc, urban share
limitations: reconstructions pre-1950; splice artefacts; schooling is attainment stock; no enrolment/child-work/tutoring
construct_mismatch: attainment stock vs participation flow; no MASSENG states

name: Transition onset/timing record
unit: country x year panel + onset years (mortality/fertility decline; 197 countries)
vintage: OWID/UN/Maddison, Nov 2026; box2 raw downloads not committed
limitations: onset rule = first year >=10% below running peak sustained 10y; derived TFR 'shown, not used for claims'; pre-1950 coverage thin
construct_mismatch: demographic onsets only; no education/jobs events; useful as timing covariates/placebo dates

name: DHS public API cached cells
unit: survey x country x background category; published aggregates (no microdata)
coverage: 76-87 countries, 1985-2025; 369 surveys; TFR/GFR/wanted fertility, median age at first birth by education, mean CEB by education, women's education (edu2/edu4 panels)
limitations: background categories vary across surveys; no denominators for rate indicators; no child-labour/enrolment/tutoring cells
construct_mismatch: fertility/women's education only; B1 birth intervals unavailable

name: DHS CEB-by-education cells
unit: survey x country x education: mean CEB women 40-49
vintage: published DHS API cells; acquisition planning record
limitations: small country coverage; mean CEB is not parity progression; no microdata

name: Shadow-education hand-collected data
unit: country/site x year: participation and fees
limitations: no harmonised national panel; definitions differ; some case studies (e.g. one Cambodian district)
construct_mismatch: model tut_rate vs observed incidence; broad vs narrow definitions

name: asia_school_work cross-section
unit: country: oos_lower (UIS via WDI), child_labour (ILO/UNICEF estimates as tabulated on Wikipedia)
coverage: 21 countries, one row each; oos years 2015-2022, child-labour years 2010-2023; 20 with both
vintage: mixed vintages per row (file's own caveat)
limitations: years differ; admin OOS can overstate; 4 composition facts are tests only

name: Philippines CHED higher-education series
limitations: single country; headcount stock; no age/cohort; descriptive series
construct_mismatch: HE headcount vs cohort-flow tertiary enrolment share

name: Codex staging results
unit: 160 runs: 4 schedules x 2 feedback x 2 gates x 10 seeds; metrics + 70-year annual series
coverage: 160 runs; T=70; N=400 children/cohort; elapsed 16.499 s
limitations: synthetic; no empirical fit; arms not exposure-matched; no migration
construct_mismatch: no observed counterpart; designed as a timing mechanism experiment

name: Codex Bayesian screen pilot results
unit: per-draw parameters, log/normalised weights, holdout predictions; summary ESS/RMSE
coverage: 2 x 256 draws (seeds 20261124; workers 4); ESS 5.94/1.77; holdout GER RMSE 9.645/7.065 vs persistence 6.600
vintage: committed 2026-11-24; prior bounds explicit; fixed nuisance from fit_R1.json (data reuse)
limitations: importance weights only; not posterior; overflow on expanded prior; low ESS; holdout inspected
construct_mismatch: conditional on v5 model and fixed nuisance; no observed-vs-model identification

name: MASSENG v5 fitted outputs and protocols
unit: country-level fitted parameter sets and scores by version/specification
coverage: PHL v1-v5, KHM v3; PHL v5 R0-R5 fits; recovery_R2; 34 tests passed
vintage: PROTOCOL v5 written 2026-11-22 before first fit; fits 2026-11-22/23
limitations: retrospective and inspected (post-1995 seen); comparability limits on premium series

name: Massification-panel sweep/takeoff results
unit: country-level panel regressions/lead-lag/event studies/Bayesian model averaging
coverage: 58 variables; 12 SSA fee-abolition dates (unverified against primary sources); child-work B3
limitations: sweeps have no country FE; some signs implausible; B3(c) declared invalid; abolition dates unverified
construct_mismatch: associational/lead-lag, not identified; child-work series sparse

name: GPU-suite ABC-real-data experiment
unit: rejection ABC on real data (script; results archived on that branch)
construct_mismatch: separate from current work; reuse only with care

name: Engine tune protocol / tuned settings
unit: 256 shared Latin-hypercube settings; selection rules; evaluation seeds
coverage: recorded before search; seed-sensitivity amendment recorded after first pass
limitations: retrospective temporal evaluation; post-2015 inspected; seed sensitivity

name: MASSENG country facts/inputs
unit: country inputs: cohort sizes, age/cycle rules, income and premiums, formal share, policies, targets
coverage: PHL and KHM full; HKG facts only
vintage: sources recorded per file (FIES/NTA/CHED/DHS etc.); v5 drivers
limitations: hand-curated; some unverified rows excluded; no microdata
